dict.string: Otter Pocket keeps your library (your images, boards and notes) in a folder in Documents.
Otter Pocket needs access to open a library you keep on your Desktop.
Otter Pocket needs access to open a library you keep in Downloads.
Otter Pocket needs access to open a library you keep on an external drive.
Otter Pocket needs access to open a library you keep on a network drive.
Otter Pocket needs access to open a library you keep in a cloud folder such as Dropbox or Google Drive.
